description: Rename an incorrectly named document in an existing complaint case. Log in to ArkCase (admin/ArkCase1234!), navigate to the complaint case (ID provided in the setup output), and find the document currently named 'scan_20240315' with type 'Other'. Edit the document properties to rename it to 'Response_Letter_March2025' and change the Document Type to 'Correspondence'. Save the changes.
